fusions.name: Crumb Gnaw
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to make it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skirting Burst
fusions.desc: Circles you at speed, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Under the Floorboards
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 25% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Last Crumb
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you recover 15 stamina and gain 8% dodge chance. Once every 30 seconds.
